Cross-origin media and XHR fixture

This page sits on one of the fixture server's origins and loads from the other (…): a clip in a media element, then the clip, the server's JSON and a 200,000-byte video/mp4 answer through fetch and XMLHttpRequest, each once without and once with Access-Control-Expose-Headers, plus one answer without Access-Control-Allow-Origin and the clip from the page's own origin for comparison. Per load it records the response headers the browser lets the page read (response.headers, getAllResponseHeaders()) on window.__xo, which is what a page script observing the page's own requests could hand a request observer.
